snippet.title: Motocross The Game - MTG Gameplay January 2026 (WIP)
snippet.description:
You asked for it, we delivered.

Here is a full gameplay video showing the current state of Motocross The Game as of January 2026. This footage reflects real in game development progress and ongoing improvements.

If you would like to follow the evolution of the project in detail, you can read all of our monthly development updates on Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/virtualmx/motocross-the-game/posts

Thank you for your continuous support. Your feedback and engagement truly help us push the game further.

Motocross The Game is the game that gamers have been dreaming of for decades: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator based on online competition, available on both PC and next-gen consoles, with cross-play capabilities.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://mxthega.me/steam
